_readme: Termux config that uses a REAL MCP server (not the no-MCP script tools).
Then:         cp config.termux-mcp.json config.json && bash start-termux.sh
The first launch downloads the server via npx and can take a few minutes on
a phone; the bridge waits. Later launches are fast (npm caches it).
IMPORTANT: replace the last argument below with the folder you want the AI
to have access to. The filesystem server can ONLY touch that folder.
Verified working: this server advertises 14 tools (read_text_file,
Prefer no MCP at all? Use config.termux.json instead - see NO-MCP.md.
